name: The Langham Jakarta
insider_take: Where British elegance meets Indonesian warmth in the heart of Jakarta's golden triangle.
whats_special: The Langham Jakarta stands as the first Langham property in Southeast Asia, featuring the brand's signature pink afternoon tea tradition and Europe's largest Chuan Body + Soul spa concept. Located in the prestigious Sudirman Central Business District, this 62-story tower offers unparalleled city views and houses one of Jakarta's most extensive art collections.
pro_tip: Book the signature afternoon tea at T Lounge during weekdays to avoid crowds and enjoy the full British ritual with Indonesian touches like pandan macarons and local tea blends.
dont_miss: The rooftop Alice restaurant on the 62nd floor for panoramic Jakarta skyline views, and the hotel's connection to Plaza Indonesia shopping center - perfect for luxury retail therapy without stepping outside.
pros: Exceptional luxury service and attention to detail
Prime central Jakarta location with easy access to business district
World-class dining options and culinary experiences
Elegant rooms and suites with premium amenities
cons: Located in busy urban area with city traffic
